name: Endou Satoru
source:
1st year high school student.
The protagonist's and [url=/c49296]Riito's[/url] childhood friend. He lives in the same neighborhood and is like a little brother to them.
He likes taking care of animals and gardening. He's often seen taking care of the school animals on his own free time.
He's classmates with [url=/c49297]Ruka[/url] and they seem to get along well.
